evidence: A user reports running dozens of agents for tasks such as equity analysis and finding the information surfaced from large datasets surprising.

evidence_sources.excerpt: For non coding usecases, I use https://www.ctlflow.com. This lets me run dozens of agents on tasks like equity analysis. The information a swarm of agents can surface from a large data store can be quite surprising.
